key_insight: A coding agent can search directly for explicit, interpretable feedback laws for active flow control and achieve performance comparable to or better than DRL.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical controller-design alternative for expensive fluid simulations, where interpretability and simulator efficiency matter as much as raw reward.
method: Use a constrained heuristic-learning protocol where the agent proposes executable controller code.
Evaluate each candidate only through the public benchmark interface under fixed simulation budgets.
Iteratively revise the code to improve feedback behavior across multiple flow-control environments.
evidence_signal: On 13 active flow-control benchmarks, the discovered heuristic controllers matched or outperformed the strongest DRL baselines in 10 environments under identical simulation budgets.
watch_item: Results depend on benchmark access and the quality of the coding agent’s search, so transfer to real-world experimental systems may require careful validation.
paper_title: Heuristic Learning for Active Flow Control Using Coding Agents
